_readme: S644, 2026-11-13. Capture-only run 43338146577 (branch claude/harvest-sjcc-s644) found 7 of San Jose City's 90 programs with a closed list. Each of the 82 not found has a near miss on a page whose address names its award and title (79 distinct degrees-certificates pages), yet the coarse net reads 0 of the program's listed courses there (Accounting A.S.: 0 of 9). The state's file stores this college's course codes as 'Accounting (ACCTG) 101' (718 of 748 rows in unified_courses_members.js), which norm_code() reads as ACCOUNTING(ACCTG)101 and never matches a printed ACCTG 101. This read loads two program pages as the capture reads them, to see the codes as the catalog prints them: one the capture missed (Accounting A.S.) and one it found (Art A.S.). Two loads, no model call.

questions.printed_codes: How a San Jose City program page prints its course codes in the Requirements tab, as the capture reads it.
